公司簡介
CORPORATE PROFILE

華潤水泥控股有限公司於二零零三年三月十三日根據開曼群島公司法在開曼群島註冊成立為一家獲豁免的有限公司，
並為華潤集團所有水泥及混凝土業務的控股公司。


本公司曾於二零零三年七月二十九日以介紹形式在香港聯合交易所有限公司主板上市。於二零零六年，本公司被華潤
（集團）有限公司私有化成為順創投資有限公司（現稱華潤集團（水泥）有限公司）的全資附屬公司，並於二零零六年七
月二十六日撤銷其股份在聯交所的上市地位。


本公司於二零零九年十月六日以全球發售形式重新於聯交所主板上市。於本報告日期，本公司已發行股份總數為
6,982,937,817 股，其中華潤集團持有約 68.72% 的本公司已發行股份。


China Resources Cement Holdings Limited was incorporated on 13 March 2003 in the Cayman Islands as an
exempted company with limited liability under the Companies Law of the Cayman Islands and is the holding
company of all the cement and concrete operations of China Resources Group.


The Company was listed on the main board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited on 29 July 2003 by way of
introduction. In 2006, the Company was privatized as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Smooth Concept Investments
Limited (currently known as CRH (Cement) Limited) by China Resources (Holdings) Company Limited and the listing
of the Company’s shares on the Stock Exchange was withdrawn on 26 July 2006.


The Company was re-listed on the main board of the Stock Exchange on 6 October 2009 by way of a global offering.
As at the date of this report, the total number of issued shares of the Company was 6,982,937,817 shares, of which
China Resources Group is holding approximately 68.72% of the issued shares of the Company.

     路、鐵路及公路物流網絡，產品主要在廣東、                             clinker and concrete. Products are mainly sold in Guangdong,

     路、公路、地鐵、橋樑、機場、港口、水壩、                             networks. The Group’s products are primarily used in the
     水電站及核電站等，並用於建造高層建築物以                             construction of infrastructure projects such as railways, highways,

                                      select and recommend suitable candidates of directorship.

慮：品格與誠信；各方面的素質，包括但不限                  Nomination Committee would consider character and integrity;

  策及程序足夠及適當。                                    risks. It also reviews and monitors the effectiveness of the risk

意見                           OPINION
本核數師（以下簡稱「我們」）已審計列載於第        We have audited the consolidated financial statements of China

  4.    重大會計政策                                      4.   SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES
        綜合財務報表已根據香港會計師公會頒                                The consolidated financial statements have been prepared in
        佈的香港財務報告準則編製。此外，綜                                accordance with HKFRSs issued by the HKICPA. In addition,
        合財務報表包括香港聯合交易所有限公                                the consolidated financial statements include applicable
        司證券上市規則及香港公司條例所規定                                disclosures required by the Rules Governing the Listing of
        的適用披露事項。                                         Securities on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited and
                                                         by the Hong Kong Companies Ordinance.


        綜合財務報表已按歷史成本基準編製，                                The consolidated financial statements have been prepared on
        惟投資物業、按公平價值計入其他全面                                the historical cost basis, except for investment property,
        收益的權益投資及若干應收貿易賬款按                                equity investment designated at fair value through other
        公平價值計量除外（請參閱下文所載會計                               comprehensive income and certain trade receivables, which
        政策）。                                             have been measured at fair value, as explained in the
                                                         accounting policies set out below.


        歷史成本一般根據貨物交換所得代價的                                Historical cost is generally based on the fair value of the
        公平價值而釐定。                                         consideration given in exchange for goods.


        公平價值是於計量日市場參與者於有秩                                Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset
        序交易中出售資產可收取或轉讓負債須                                or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between
        支付的價格，而不論該價格是否可使用                                market participants at the measurement date, regardless of
        其他估值方法直接可觀察或估計。於估                                whether that price is directly observable or estimated using
        計資產或負債的公平價值時，本集團會                                another valuation technique. In estimating the fair value of an
        考慮市場參與者於計量日對資產或負債                                asset or a liability, the Group takes into account the
        定價時所考慮的資產或負債特點。該等                                characteristics of the asset or liability if market participants
        綜合財務報表中作計量及╱或披露用途                                would take those characteristics into account when pricing
        的公平價值乃按此基準釐定，惟香港財                                the asset or liability at the measurement date. Fair value for
        務報告準則第 2 號範圍內的以股份支付                              measurement and/or disclosure purposes in these
        交易、香港財務報告準則第 16 號範圍內                             consolidated financial statements is determined on such a
        的租賃交易，以及與公平價值相似但並                                basis, except for share-based payment transactions that are
        非公平價值的項目計量（例如香港會計準                               within the scope of HKFRS 2, leasing transactions that are
        則第 2 號的可變現淨值或香港會計準則                              within the scope of HKFRS 16, and measurements that have
        第 36 號的使用價值）除外。                                  some similarities to fair value but are not fair value, such as
                                                         net realizable value in HKAS 2 or value in use in HKAS 36.

                                  (Continued)

     此外，就財務呈報而言，公平價值計量            In addition, for financial reporting purposes, fair value
     根據公平價值計量的輸入數據可觀察程            measurements are categorized into Level 1, 2 or 3 based on
     度及公平價值計量的輸入數據對其整體            the degree to which the inputs to the fair value measurements

     詳情如下：                        value measurement in its entirety, which are described as
                                  follows:

          量日獲得的就相同的資產或負債於               markets for identical assets or liabilities that the entity
          活躍市場的報價（未調整）；                 can access at the measurement date;


     •    第二級輸入數據為不包括第一級報         •     Level 2 inputs are inputs, other than quoted prices
          價的資產或負債的可直接或間接觀               included within Level 1, that are observable for the asset

        金融資產減值                                           Impairment of financial assets

        本集團就並非按公平價值計入損益持有                                The Group recognizes an allowance for expected credit losses
        的所有債務工具確認預期信貸虧損（「預                               (“ECLs”) for all debt instruments not held at fair value through
        期信貸虧損」）撥備。預期信貸虧損乃基                               profit or loss. ECLs are based on the difference between the
        於根據合約到期的合約現金流量與本集                                contractual cash flows due in accordance with the contract
        團預期收取並按原始實際利率的概約利                                and all the cash flows that the Group expects to receive,
        率折現的所有現金流量之間的差額釐                                 discounted at an approximation of the original effective
        定。預期現金流量將包括出售所持抵押                                interest rate. The expected cash flows will include cash flows
        品或合約條款所包含的其他信貸升級措                                from the sale of collateral held or other credit enhancements
        施所得的現金流量。                                        that are integral to the contractual terms.


        一般法                                              General approach

        預期信貸虧損分兩個階段確認。就首次                                ECLs are recognized in two stages. For credit exposures for
        確認以來信貸風險並無大幅增加的信貸                                which there has not been a significant increase in credit risk
        敞口而言，會為未來 12 個月（12 個月預                           since initial recognition, ECLs are provided for credit losses
        期信貸虧損）可能發生的違約事件所產生                               that result from default events that are possible within the
        的信貸虧損計提預期信貸虧損撥備。就                                next 12 months (a 12 month ECL). For those credit exposures
        首次確認以來信貸風險大幅增加的信貸                                for which there has been a significant increase in credit risk
        敞口而言，須就預期於敝口的餘下年期                                since initial recognition, a loss allowance is required for credit
        產生的信貸虧損計提虧損撥備，不論違                                losses expected over the remaining life of the exposure,
        約的時間（全期預期信貸虧損）。                                  irrespective of the timing of the default (a lifetime ECL).


        於各報告日期，本集團評估金融工具的                                At each reporting date, the Group assesses whether the
        信貸風險自首次確認以來是否已大幅增                                credit risk on a financial instrument has increased significantly
        加。於作出該評估時，本集團將於報告                                since initial recognition. When making the assessment, the
        日期金融工具發生的違約風險與於首次                                Group compares the risk of a default occurring on the
        確認日期金融工具發生的違約風險進行                                financial instrument as at the reporting date with the risk of a
        比較，及考慮毋須付出成本或精力即可                                default occurring on the financial instrument as at the date of
        獲得的合理及可靠資料（包括歷史及前瞻                               initial recognition and considers reasonable and supportable
        性資料）。                                            information that is available without undue cost or effort,
                                                         including historical and forward-looking information.


        當內部或外部資料反映，在沒有計及任                                The Group may consider a financial asset to be in default
        何現有信貸提升措施前，本集團不大可                                when internal or external information indicates that the Group
        能悉數收到未償還合約款項，則本集團                                is unlikely to receive the outstanding contractual amounts in
        可認為金融資產違約。倘無法合理預期                                full before taking into account any credit enhancements held
        收回合約現金流量，則撇銷金融資產。                                by the Group. A financial asset is written off when there is no
